name: 01-open-local
note: GUI opens isolated DOCX-MIN-001 copy with original one-line body, page count 1.

name: 02-save-risk
note: Ctrl+S shows ownership/ACL/extended attributes/other named stream warning, offers Cancel / Save copy (default) / Replace original; source hash unchanged at prompt.

name: 03-save-copy
note: Save copy writes edited text to saved-copy.docx; original SHA256 unchanged; GUI says original not replaced.

name: 04-save-original
note: Explicit replacement succeeds; Chinese insertion read back; creation time and Zone.Identifier preserved. ACL owner/ACE entries unchanged but raw SDDL gains DACL auto-inherited control flag, so no exact ACL preservation claim.

name: 05-ime-preedit
note: Physical key a invokes active Windows Chinese IME candidate window next to caret; status composing.

name: 06-ime-cancel
note: Escape clears preedit and returns clean document unchanged.

name: 07-ime-nihao
note: Real Windows IME nihao composition, candidate 1 is 你好 and candidate box tracks caret.

name: 08-ime-commit
note: IME commits 你好 as document text and marks unsaved.

name: 09-ime-undo
note: One Ctrl+Z removes both committed Chinese characters; earlier saved insertion remains.

name: 10-typing-abc
note: Three physical Latin keys a,b,c produce abc in English mode.

name: 11-typing-undo
note: One Ctrl+Z removes abc together while preserving prior saved text.

name: 12-system-paste
note: Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V duplicates original test text and wraps across two lines.

name: 13-system-paste-undo
note: One Ctrl+Z removes the pasted block and restores prior text, distinct from typing and IME commits.

name: 14-second-save
note: Second Ctrl+S confirmed replacement succeeds without source identity conflict; readback includes 二次保存.

name: 15-undo-after-save
note: Ctrl+Z after replacement removes only 二次保存 and leaves saved earlier insertion.

name: 16-undo-resave
note: Third original replacement succeeds after undo; raw readback returns to first saved text.
